cap: Lymph follows each organ's arteries. The gonads keep their aortic vessels and drain to para-aortic nodes; the uterus, cervix, upper vagina, prostate and bladder drain to iliac and obturator nodes; perineal skin and lining, including the scrotum, vulva, lower vagina and anal canal below the pectinate line, drain to superficial inguinal nodes; the glans drains to deep inguinal nodes.
